# Command reference

Every option `openscore` accepts, generated from its own `-h`. Run `openscore -h` for the same list in a terminal.

```
openscore DOMAIN [options]
       openscore --update
       openscore -h
```

OpenScore: free, open-source external security rating and attack-surface review for defenders, vulnerability management and authorized penetration tests. Grades a domain A-F across 8 factors, with evidence, remediation and verify steps for every finding.

## Domain

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| `DOMAIN` | Primary domain to rate, e.g. example.com |

## General

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| `-h`, `--help` | Show the help and exit |
| `--client` `NAME` | Client/organization name shown in the report |
| `-o`, `--output` `DIR` | Output directory (default: ./reports) |
| `--open` | Open the HTML report in your browser when done |

## Scope

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--ips` `CIDR ...` | Client-owned IPs/ranges to include (e.g. 203.0.113.0/28) |
| `--hosts` `HOST ...` | Extra hostnames/IPs to include |
| `--url` `URL ...` | Extra web endpoints (e.g. https://vpn.example.com:10443) |
| `--exclude` `HOST ...` | Hostnames to skip |
| `--no-discovery` | Skip subdomain discovery (apex + www + supplied hosts only) |
| `--max-hosts` `N` | Cap on discovered hosts (default 60) |

## Active checks (require written authorization)

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--active` | Enable port scan, path probes, CORS, nuclei, testssl.sh |
| `--authorization` `REF` | Reference to written authorization, e.g. "SOW-114 signed J.Smith 2026-11-01" |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Don't prompt for scope confirmation |
| `--full-ports` | Scan all 65535 TCP ports (slow) |
| `--scan-cdn` | Also port-scan CDN/SaaS IPs (normally skipped) |
| `--no-nuclei` | Skip nuclei (the slowest active step) |
| `--nuclei-rate` `N` | nuclei target requests per second, shared by all sites (default 100) |
| `--nuclei-timeout` `MIN` | Stop nuclei after MIN minutes and keep what it found (default 60) |
| `--no-testssl` | Skip testssl.sh (about 1-2 minutes per HTTPS host) |
| `--testssl-timeout` `MIN` | Stop testssl.sh on a host after MIN minutes and keep what it found (default 5) |
| `--delay` `SEC` | Seconds between probe requests per host (default 0.25) |

## API keys (prefer the environment variables; flags end up in shell history)

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--abuseipdb-key` `KEY` | default: $ABUSEIPDB_KEY |
| `--greynoise-key` `KEY` | default: $GREYNOISE_KEY |
| `--hibp-key` `KEY` | default: $HIBP_KEY |

## Report and evidence

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--suppressions` `FILE` | Suppressions TOML (default: suppressions/&lt;domain>.toml if present) |
| `--emit-suppressions` | Also write a commented suppressions template listing every open finding |
| `--baseline` `FILE` | Previous OpenScore JSON to compare against (default: latest in output dir) |
| `--no-baseline` | Don't compare with a previous scan |
| `--no-screenshots` | Skip screenshot evidence |
| `--max-screenshots` `N` | Cap on page screenshots per scan (default 60) |
| `--max-proof-images` `N` | Cap on PNG evidence exhibits exported per scan (default 250) |

## Advanced

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--resolver` `IP ...` | DNS resolver IP(s) (default: system) |
| `--dkim-selectors` `SEL ...` | Extra DKIM selectors to check |
| `--threads` `N` | Parallel workers (default 8) |
| `--timeout` `SEC` | Network timeout per request (default 12) |
| `--user-agent` `UA` | HTTP User-Agent (default identifies OpenScore) |
| `-v`, `--verbose` | Debug logging |

## Other

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--update` | Update OpenScore from git (downloads only the changes) and exit; no scan |
| `--version` | Print the version and exit |

## Examples and output (from `openscore -h`)

```
examples:
  passive scan (safe on any domain):
    openscore example.com --client "Example Inc" --open

  full scan (ONLY with written permission from the owner):
    openscore example.com --ips 203.0.113.0/28 --active \
        --authorization "SOW-114 signed J.Smith 2026-11-01" --open

  quicker active scan (skip the slowest tools):
    openscore example.com --active --authorization "..." --no-nuclei --no-testssl

  scan specific endpoints only (no subdomain discovery):
    openscore example.com --no-discovery --url https://vpn.example.com:10443/

  update OpenScore (git installs; downloads only what changed):
    openscore --update

modes:
  passive  DNS, email, certificate logs, reputation and Shodan data; no contact with the target
  light    normal-visitor web/TLS requests (always on)
  active   port scan, path probes, CORS, nuclei, testssl.sh; needs --active + --authorization
           and a typed scope confirmation, and every action is written to the audit log

API keys (optional; set as environment variables rather than flags):
  ABUSEIPDB_KEY   free at https://www.abuseipdb.com/account/api
  GREYNOISE_KEY   free community key
  HIBP_KEY        paid; your domain must be verified in Have I Been Pwned

output (./reports by default):
  <domain>-<time>.html   the report        <domain>-<time>.json   machine-readable data
  <domain>-<time>.audit.log                <domain>-<time>-evidence/   PNG exhibits + screenshots

(On Windows use .\openscore.bat; from a source checkout: python3 -m openscore)
```
